# Appendix: Additional Material {#sec-appendix}

Appendix content. Quarto automatically labels and numbers appendices
distinctly from main-matter chapters: this one is Appendix A, and its
sections, figures, tables and equations take the letter with them.

## A section in the appendix

Numbering continues within the appendix, so this section is A.1 and a
display equation here is (A.1):

$$
\mathrm{Var}(\hat{\beta}) = \sigma^2 (X'X)^{-1}
$$ {#eq-app-var}

@eq-app-var behaves like any other cross-reference.

Add further appendices by listing them under `appendices:` in
`_quarto.yml`; each becomes B, C, and so on. Everything documented in
@sec-chapter1 and @sec-chapter2 works here unchanged.
